Bengaluru Daycare Abuse Allegations Lead to Arrests and Investigations

Multiple Indian news outlets have reported on alleged child abuse at a daycare center located on the Capgemini campus in Bengaluru. Videos surfaced online showing toddlers being mistreated, leading to the arrest of several staff members. Investigations are ongoing, with authorities looking into the allegations and the circumstances surrounding the firings of a whistleblower.
